apps.subtitle: Download, install and share App Store IPAs
apps.localizedDescription: An iOS app inspired by ipatool. Sign in with your Apple ID to search the App Store, download any app as an IPA, including older versions, and install or share it without a jailbreak.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed 

- Fixed authentication issues
- Multi-language support (AI translations):
  - Chinese, Simplified
  - French
  - German
  - Hindi
  - Indonesian
  - Italian
  - Japanese
  - Korean
  - Russian
  - Spanish
  - Turkish
  - Vietnamese
